messages:
emma (PM): starting thread to finalize the guarded regional shepherding plan for rollout_routing_guard_v1. objective: phased regional activation + deterministic fallbacks + clear owner/rescue path. posting proposed knobs and checks.

raj (Eng): OK. want to confirm fallback order and whether we tie backoffs to model variant health or route-level shed. recommend variant-first (lighter model) then route-level degrade.

harper (SRE): Circuit proposal: soft-trigger = p95 > 650ms for 3m OR error% > 0.9% over 5m -> move to degraded variant and page if persists 5m; hard-trigger = p95 > 1100ms OR error% > 2.5% -> immediate rollback to previous global stable and open incident. Also add GPU util > 92% as a hard trigger.

leo (Data): quality gates for staged ramp: fidelity_delta <= 1.5% AND hallucination_rate change < 0.5pp. run an initial 2% cohort in eu-west-1 for 48h to baseline signals. collect cohort-level CTR and support_contact_rate as secondary signals.

maria (Solutions): Customer opt-out/preview: provide per-tenant toggle in console + private preview dashboard. wording: "Preview: examine candidate vs production responses; your live traffic unchanged unless you opt into degraded path."

emma (PM): rollout cadence suggestion: 0% -> 0.2% (15m) -> 1% (1h) -> 5% (6h) -> 20% (18h) -> 60% (72h) -> 100%. checkpoints: data review at 1%, 5%, 20%. Owners: raj infra, leo metrics, harper runbook.

raj (Eng): routing fallback stack: primary=full-model, fallback1=quantized-model, fallback2=KV-cached-prefix, fallback3=short-summarizer, fallback4=stub-text. Implement per-region routing weights and a global safety-cap (no region > 8% unless manual override).

harper (SRE): automated backoff: if soft-trigger fires during ramp, reduce target pct by 50% and hold for 30m; if it retriggers twice within 2h, rollback region to previous stable. Log traces to retention 45d for postmortem.

leo (Data): A/B plan: use randomized cohorts with exposed cohort and 1% holdback control. compute fidelity_delta with prometheus derived metric and send alerts if beyond thresholds. include a daily digest for PMs and engineers.

maria (Solutions): For enterprise customers request path: allow tenant-level opt-in to move directly to degraded routing for stress testing behind NDA. Need sign-off flow in console and a billing note for cost delta.

emma (PM): action items: raj -> flag schema + CLI examples and PR (due Tue); leo -> dashboard tiles + automated gating queries (due Tue); harper -> runbook updates + tabletop invite (due Mon); maria -> customer copy + opt-in flow spec (due Wed). I'll draft launch comms and approval checklist.

deploy-bot: rollout_routing_guard_v1 scheduled for canary at 2026-07-15T10:00Z.

raj (Eng): will name flag `flag.rollout.routing_guard_v1` and add CLI helper: `redwood rollout set flag.rollout.routing_guard_v1 --region eu-west-1 --pct 1`. posting PR when ready.

emma (PM): thanks all  tagging #oncall and #customer-success for visibility. will update thread with test results after initial 2% cohort.
